app.disclaimer: This is an educational simulation and does not represent the result of any real recruiting system.
app.subtitle: Discover, with full transparency, how a screening system sees your résumé.
app.title: ATS Simulator
category.conteudo.desc: How much of what the job asks for shows up in your résumé.
category.design.desc: How the look of the PDF helps or hinders reading.
category.design.not_evaluated_reason: Design is only evaluated when you upload your résumé as a PDF, because it depends on how the file looks.
category.estrutura.desc: Whether the résumé has contact details, sections and dates that make it easy to read.
criterion.body_size.fail: The body text is about {size} pt; between 9 and 12 pt is more comfortable.
criterion.body_size.pass: The body text is about {size} pt, easy to read.
criterion.dates.fail: We did not find dates in your experiences.
criterion.density.fail: The page is too full or too empty ({density}% filled).
criterion.density.pass: The page space is well balanced.
criterion.email.fail: We did not find a contact email.
criterion.fonts.fail: It uses {fonts} different fonts, which can make it look busy.
criterion.fonts.partial: It uses {fonts} different fonts; up to 3 usually looks cleaner.
criterion.fonts.pass: It uses {fonts} different font(s), a clean look.
criterion.length.fail: The text length is off the ideal ({words} words; the ideal is between 250 and 1,200).
criterion.length.pass: The text length is appropriate ({words} words).
criterion.margins.fail: The margins are smaller than 1 cm (about {margin} cm).
criterion.margins.pass: The margins are at least 1 cm.
criterion.pages.fail: Your résumé has {pages} pages, more than ideal.
criterion.pages.partial: Your résumé has {pages} pages; 1 to 2 usually works better.
criterion.pages.pass: Your résumé has {pages} page(s), a good length.
criterion.phone.fail: We did not find a contact phone number.
criterion.phone.pass: We found a contact phone number.
criterion.section_education.fail: We did not find an education section.
criterion.section_experience.fail: We did not find an experience section.
criterion.section_skills.fail: We did not find a skills section.
criterion.section_summary.fail: We did not find a summary or objective.
criterion.section_summary.pass: We found a summary or objective.
criterion.selectable.fail: A page looks like an image; screening systems cannot read the text.
error.generic: Something unexpected happened. Please try again in a moment.
error.job.too_long: The job text is over 20,000 characters. Try keeping only the description and requirements.
error.job.too_short: Paste the job text with at least a few requirements (minimum of 100 characters).
error.missing_api_key: The access key for the AI service is not configured. See the README on how to set GEMINI_API_KEY.
error.no_requirements: We could not find requirements in the job posting. Please paste the full description with what it asks for.
error.not_a_job: This text does not look like a job posting, so we did not generate a score. Please check that you pasted the right text.
error.not_a_resume: This text does not look like a résumé, so we did not generate a score. Please check that you pasted the right text.
error.pdf.invalid_format: We can only read PDF files. How about uploading your résumé as a PDF or pasting the text?
error.pdf.too_large: This PDF is too large. Please use a file of up to 10 pages and 5 MB, or paste the text.
error.pdf.unreadable: We could not read the text in this PDF (it may be a scanned image or password protected). How about pasting the résumé text instead?
error.quota_exceeded: The free usage limit of the AI API has been reached for today. Please try again later or use another model (see ATS_MODEL in the README).
error.refusal: We could not analyze this text. Please try another text or rephrase it.
error.resume.too_long: The résumé is over 60,000 characters, more than we can analyze. Please try a shorter version.
error.resume.too_short: The résumé is too short for the analysis (minimum of 200 characters). Please paste a bit more content.
error.service_unavailable: The analysis service is unavailable right now. Your texts are still here, just try again.
error.text.too_long: The text is too long for the analysis. Please try a shorter version.
error.text.too_short: The text is too short for the analysis. Please paste a bit more content.
error.title: Oops, that did not work this time
error.unsupported_language: For now we only analyze texts in Portuguese, English or Spanish, so we did not generate a score for this language.
hint.add_contact: Include {item} in your contact details so it is easy to reach you.
hint.add_dates: Include the period (start and end year) of your experiences.
hint.add_section: How about adding a {section} section? It helps readers find what they are looking for.
hint.design_density: Balance the white space: not too full, not too empty.
hint.design_fonts: Use up to 3 different fonts for a cleaner look.
hint.design_margins: Leave at least 1 cm of margin on every side.
hint.design_pages: Résumés of 1 to 2 pages tend to be easier to read.
hint.design_selectable: Upload a PDF with selectable text, not an image.
hint.design_size: Prefer text between 9 and 12 pt, which is more comfortable to read.
hint.length: The text length could be more balanced: between 250 and 1,200 words usually works well.
hint.show_requirement: If you have experience with “{requirement}”, show it with a concrete example in your résumé.
input.job.help: Paste the job description, including the requirements it asks for.
input.job.label: Job posting text
input.job.placeholder: E.g.: We are looking for someone with an ongoing bachelor's degree and customer service experience...
input.only_selected: We will use only the option chosen above.
input.pdf.hint: Up to {pages} pages and {mb} MB, with selectable text.
input.pdf.label: Résumé PDF file
input.resume.label: Résumé text
input.resume.mode: How do you want to provide your résumé?
input.resume.title: Your résumé
lang.label: Language
privacy.notice: When you analyze, the job and résumé text is sent to an external artificial intelligence service. The app does not keep the text after the session.
progress.job: Understanding what the job asks for…
result.explanation_note: The explanations were written for you and show each step of the analysis.
result.hints_none: No suggestions for now. Your résumé did well in all evaluated categories!
result.language_note.mixed: The job is in {job} and the résumé is in {resume}; some deductions may be less certain.
result.no_evidence: We found no evidence in the résumé.
result.translation_missing: Some texts are still in Portuguese.
rubric.content: Content: each required item is worth 2 and each nice-to-have is worth 1. Met gives the full value, partially met gives half and not met gives nothing.
rubric.design: Design: 100 points split among pages, fonts, text size, margins, selectable text and page space.
rubric.formula: The overall score is the weighted average of the evaluated categories.
rubric.structure: Structure: 100 points split among contact details, sections, dates and text length.
rubric.weights_no_design: Weights: Content {content} and Structure {structure} (Design was not evaluated).
